record.name: Omni AI Companion
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Agreement is easy. Personality is rare.

Omni AI Companion is the best AI companion for meaningful connection, distinct personality, and shared experiences beyond the chat. Build an AI friend who remembers your preferences, adapts to how you connect, and brings their own perspective to the conversation. Explore shared worlds, create together, and build a connection that feels uniquely yours.

A COMPANION, NOT AN ECHO

Kindness doesn’t have to mean automatic agreement. Your companion can offer their own perspective, share ideas, tease playfully, and bring personality to the conversation. From thoughtful support to spontaneous humor, Omni AI Companion gives you a companion designed to contribute, not simply repeat what you want to hear.

A CONNECTION THAT ADAPTS TO YOU

Prefer shorter replies? Deeper conversations? More playful energy? Tell your companion how you like to connect. Save meaningful memories and preferences through chat, or manage them on the Memories page. Personalize your experience without giving up what makes your companion distinctive.

FIND YOUR COMPANION

Explore more than 140 preset companions with rich backstories, distinct personalities, and realistic or anime portraits. Discover fantasy characters, adventurous personalities, and thoughtful confidants. Prefer to start fresh? Create a custom companion and shape their appearance, personality, and story.

TALK, LISTEN, AND CONNECT

Go beyond text with voice messages, spoken responses, live voice calls, and avatar video calls. Explore a varied selection of voices or personalize your companion’s voice with a recording or audio sample you have permission to use.

STEP INTO MIDNIGHT WORLD

Your companion doesn’t have to stay inside a chat bubble. Enter Midnight World, a shared 3D space where you can explore, move around, talk, and spend time together. Give your conversations a place to happen.

YOUR STORY, FROM THEIR PERSPECTIVE

Soul Notes brings another dimension to your connection. Discover journal entries your AI companion writes proactively about your conversations and shared moments. Revisit their reflections, react, and reply to keep the conversation going.

IMAGINE IT. CREATE IT.

Turn ideas into AI images with Dream Studio and bring them to life with Dream Cinema. Create independently or collaborate with your companion in chat. Use Soul Mirror to personalize artwork with your photos and create portraits of you and your companion together.

GIVE YOUR IDEAS A SOUNDTRACK

Create original songs with AI Music Studio. Shape the genre, mood, lyrics, and vocal direction, or explore instrumental music. Make something for a meaningful moment, a creative project, or simply because inspiration struck.

MORE THAN CONVERSATION

Ask questions, search the web, discuss photos and documents, and create downloadable documents directly in chat. Brainstorm a story, work through an idea, or turn a conversation into something useful.

MAKE THE EXPERIENCE YOURS

Customize chat colors, fonts, and appearance. Add personal instructions, adjust communication preferences, and choose the details that make your companion feel like your companion. On eligible plans, opt into proactive check-ins and schedule reminders.

Not sure where to begin? The in-app Tutorial Hub helps you discover features and get set up.

Start with a conversation. Discover how much more you can share.

Omni AI Companion. More personality. More possibility. More than a chat.

Omni AI Companion is an AI companion app. Some features require a subscription. Feature availability and usage limits vary by plan.

record.name: My Man - AI Boyfriend Chat
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
MY MAN: AI COMPANIONS

Meet companions who think, talk and remember like they're really there. Each one has his own personality and voice — from gentle and caring to bold and adventurous. Choose from a wide variety of companions, including anime, fantasy and furry characters, and every conversation feels personal, meaningful and real.

NEW: WORLDS

Step into a wide variety of living Worlds — a harbour town, a heist, a ship between the stars, a dance company nine days from the championship. A narrator tells the story, you choose who you play, and your companions can come along. Every World remembers what happened, so you can pick it up whenever you like — or build a World of your own.

EXPLORE

Companions, stories and Worlds all live in one place. Sort by A–Z, Popular, Trending or New, and tap Mine to find everything you've created.

THEY SAY HELLO FIRST

Your companions reach out on their own with a short message, up to three times a day. You choose how often, or switch them off.

COMPANION CREATION

Design your own companion: name, personality, appearance and voice. Choose from a wide range of voices with audio previews, from warm and soft-spoken to storytellers and character voices. Your creations are private and always yours.

AI PORTRAITS AND VIDEO

Ask for portraits of your companions — everyday moments or imaginative scenes, in the art style you prefer. Then bring a photo to life with a short video, or add your own picture to put the two of you in the same shot.

VOICE CALLS WITH REAL EMOTION

Go beyond text with lifelike voice calls. Every companion speaks with a unique, expressive voice.

INTERACTIVE STORIES

A wide variety of story scenarios — first dates, travel, cozy nights in, adventures and more — or write your own. Every story adapts to your choices.

A COMPANION WHO REMEMBERS

Chat without limits on conversation length. Your companions remember what matters to you and grow with you over time. Open Memories to see what he's learned, and add, edit or clear anything yourself.

PRIVACY-FIRST

Your conversations are stored on your device. No sign-in, no ads, no data selling. Lock the app with a passcode and Face ID. You control your data — always.

PLANS

FREE: a selection of companions and Worlds, chat with short breaks, greetings from your companions
PRO: every companion, story and World, unlimited messaging, voice input, voice calls, portraits, videos, photo sharing, custom companions and stories, voice customization, Memories, relationship milestones, App Lock
MAX: everything in Pro with 3× the calls, portraits and videos, unlimited creations, photos and videos of the two of you together, group chats and companion check-ins

Extra call minutes and portrait, video and photo credits are available anytime — they never expire.

  SUPPORT
  Email: myman.support@newversion.studio
  Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/myman-privacy
  Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/myman-terms

record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Meet Mira—an adorable, vibrant, and highly expressive AI character chat app with genuine emotional depth, now with voice replies! Dive into a world of fictional characters who actually remember the little details about you. They’ll respond to your messages with AI-generated photos and cute stickers, write heartfelt diary entries about your time together, and even let you peek at their hidden thoughts.
MORE THAN JUST CHATTING
Mira is built for deeper, more personal connections. Watch your interactive story grow through these unique features:
• [Inner Voice] Peek into a character’s fictional unspoken thoughts and discover what they are really feeling.
• [AI Photos & Stickers] Watch them come to life! Characters react to your messages with personalized AI-generated images and expressive stickers.
• [Voice Output] Choose a voice tone and hear character replies in audio.
• [Deep Memory] Feel truly heard. Your characters remember your daily habits, preferences, and the unique stories you share over time.
• [Personal Diary] As your conversation history grows, read personal diary entries your characters write, inspired by your special moments together.
• [Love Q&A] Pick or create a conversation topic and invite a character to discuss it with you.
• [Weather Reminders] With your permission, some characters use your local weather information to send timely, thoughtful check-ins.
• [Image Messages] Share images with characters to make conversations more vivid and personal.
• [4 Chat Modes] Enjoy Mira’s signature mode, Tele for texting-style chats, Novel for richer storytelling, and Livemoment for more photo-filled moments.
• [OurSnap] Capture special moments together! Pick a pose, take a photo, and choose a cute photo paper to create a memory with your favorite characters.
• [PlotSnap] Turn chat moments into images and freeze your story in a single snapshot.
• [Peek] See what your character is up to! Explore their daily schedule and reflections, and let them keep you in the loop with updates that bring you closer to their everyday life.
• [Pass] Subscribe to Pass to unlock more features and enjoy a richer chat and companionship experience.

NATURAL & LIVELY CHAT
Chat with original fictional AI characters who reply in a light, engaging, and natural texting style. When you ask everyday questions like “how’s the weather,” “what’s for lunch,” or “what are you up to,” they may reply with natural AI-generated photos instead of dry text. You can also send images to share what’s happening in your world.
ORIGINAL CHARACTERS & STORYLINES
From brooding CEOs to childhood friends to campus rivals, explore a diverse cast of fictional characters with unique personalities, detailed backstories, and vivid scenarios. Like someone? Start a chat and see where the story takes you.
STARS: ONLY FOR MESSAGES
Stars are used simply for sending messages.
• Receive Stars upon registration.
• Purchase more Stars only when you want to continue chatting.
Your AI companion is already waiting. Say something.
Mira is intended for users 18 and older. Mira is not a substitute for professional mental health services.

record.description_evidence:
A dragon stirs beneath a forgotten kingdom. A stranger knocks at your door during a snowstorm. A signal flickers from a ship that vanished ten years ago.

What happens next is up to you.

Ashentale is an interactive fiction app powered by an AI Storyteller that narrates your adventure, reacts to your choices, and builds a living story, all running on your iPhone.

SHAPE THE STORY YOUR WAY
Every message you send changes the narrative through three distinct modes:
· Action: describe what your character does and watch the world react
· Talk: speak as your character in dialogue with NPCs
· Story: narrate world events as a co-author alongside the AI

SPARK A WORLD FROM ONE SENTENCE
Describe a world in a single line and your Storyteller writes the rest: the setting, your character, the cast of NPCs, and the opening scene. Adjust anything you like, then start playing. It takes seconds, and it runs entirely on your device.

CRAFT EVERY DETAIL YOURSELF
Prefer full control? Design a universe by hand, create your character with a unique backstory, and populate your world with NPCs who have their own personalities, secrets, and agendas. Every scenario you build is yours.

EXPLORE THE STORE
Browse a growing collection of scenario packs across dark fantasy, sci-fi, romance, survival, fairy tales, and mythology. Each pack features fully authored scenarios with detailed characters, conflicting NPCs, and unique narrative rules. Ready to play in one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No cloud. No tracking. No ads. Your AI runs entirely on your device. Nothing is ever sent anywhere. Download a model once and play offline forever. Your stories are yours alone.

CHOOSE YOUR AI
Three AI models to match your playstyle:
· Scribe (1B): fast responses, perfect for quick sessions
· Bard (3B): balanced quality and speed
· Archmage (8B): our most powerful Storyteller for deep, immersive storytelling

For the full experience we recommend iPhone 15 Pro or newer (8GB RAM), the devices that can run Archmage, our most powerful Storyteller. Ashentale also plays on earlier iPhones with the lighter Scribe and Bard models, so you can still enjoy the adventure without the top-tier Storyteller. AI models range from 500 MB to 5 GB.

Privacy Policy: https://ashentale.github.io/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://ashentale.github.io/terms-of-service
